limitations: Synthetic kernel fixture, no actual Qeli MARK/NAT implementation changed or claimed fixed.
No authenticated VPN, real firewalld daemon, restart/SIGKILL/recovery, or persistent group lease tested.
RPDB suppress_ifgroup impact follows primary kernel source; not tested with runtime policy routes in this fixture.
No protection against root intentionally copying token, nft/iptables rules or marks.
Polling cannot eliminate the interval before observation; same-name snapshot is unchanged.
next_implementation_requirements: Explicit exclusive device-group ownership contract or another kernel-bound guard; no silent administrator group mutation.
Shared WAN lease across IPv4/IPv6, server/client profiles and processes; namespace/device witness; generation token collision handling.
Crash journal, rollback/cleanup/refusal and reuse-aware recovery before group restoration; foreign policy compatibility.
Guard actual packet FORWARD/POSTROUTING, including established conntrack traffic and reserved exit marks.
Real authenticated client/server mixed-backend packet/recovery tests before D06 closure.
